Native synchronized Minecraft and Serene Seasons state, tooltips, individual toggles and F1 behavior remain. Rejected/missing art keeps both toggles disabled. Gemini concept/export and acceptance are separate gates

rationale.purpose: The user requests implementation of section4 of the final v2 brief while preserving existing architecture and source authority.
rationale.decision_source: User specified indicator size, layout, native synchronization, optional-mod behavior and presentation-only scope. Codex chose Forge client event hooks, an isolated optional adapter and native calendar API reuse. User later rejected candidate icons and reserved icon authoring. Codex selected explicit default-off delivery to permit independent food shipment without fabricating art. On 2026-10-25 user requested inventory-only top-right and selected circular Gemini icons. Codex retained the exact existing 24px native-state renderer, changed only screen admission/anchor and preserved rejected-art disablement
